jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Join TechPulse Solutions to build out our high-performance distributed workflow automation suite. You will collaborate with product designers, AI specialists, and platform engineers to deliver crisp frontend experiences and robust backend APIs.
jobs.responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain modern web applications with React, TypeScript, and Express.
• Architect relational schemas in MySQL with optimized indexing and queries.
• Collaborate in an agile sprint lifecycle with cross-functional teams.
• Maintain high unit and integration test coverage across core microservices.
jobs.required_skills: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MySQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS
jobs.qualifications: Bachelor degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical industry experience. 4+ years of professional full-stack development experience.

jobs.title: Lead Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description: Lead our core AI intelligence team researching and operationalizing multimodal generative reasoning workflows for real-time customer analytics.
jobs.responsibilities:
• Build and scale inference pipelines and LLM tooling.
• Integrate vector retrieval with structured relational databases.
• Optimize latency and inference costs across high-traffic API workloads.
• Mentor junior and mid-level machine learning engineers.
jobs.required_skills: Python, PyTorch, LLM Fine-Tuning, TypeScript, Vector DBs, MySQL
jobs.qualifications: M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science or AI/ML. 5+ years of engineering experience with at least 2 years in production ML pipelines.

jobs.title: DevOps & Cloud Security Specialist
jobs.description: CloudScale Networks is looking for an infrastructure engineer to safeguard our multi-region Kubernetes clusters and implement zero-trust telemetry.
jobs.responsibilities:
• Implement Terraform configuration-as-code across multi-cloud deployments.
• Harden Linux kernel parameters, TLS termination, and ingress security.
• Automate CI/CD pipelines with comprehensive vulnerability scanning.
• Conduct chaos engineering audits and disaster recovery drills.
jobs.required_skills: Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, AWS, Linux, CI/CD, Network Security
jobs.qualifications: B.S. in Computer Science or related degree. 3+ years in cloud infrastructure and security compliance.

jobs.title: Senior Quantitative Risk Analyst
jobs.description: Nova Financial is expanding our algorithmic risk management group. You will formulate probabilistic risk models for high-velocity trade settlement.
jobs.responsibilities:
• Formulate mathematical and statistical models for market and liquidity risk.
• Query multi-gigabyte transactional ledgers using high-performance SQL.
• Partner with algorithmic trading desks to backtest real-time signals.
• Build executive risk visualization dashboards.
jobs.required_skills: SQL, Python, Risk Modeling, Financial Derivatives, Monte Carlo Simulations
jobs.qualifications: Master or advanced degree in Financial Engineering, Mathematics, or Econometrics. 4+ years in quantitative trading or risk analysis.

jobs.title: Product Design Lead (UI/UX)
jobs.description: Lead end-to-end design across our suite of collaboration tools. Transform complex enterprise workflows into intuitive, beautiful experiences.
jobs.responsibilities:
• Conduct user interviews and synthesize actionable research insights.
• Create high-fidelity design systems, components, and prototypes in Figma.
• Partner closely with frontend engineers to ensure pixel-perfect fidelity.
• Champion accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and micro-interactions.
jobs.required_skills: Figma, UI/UX Design, Design Systems, User Research, Prototyping
jobs.qualifications: 5+ years designing enterprise or developer-facing web applications with a standout portfolio.

jobs.title: Frontend React Intern
jobs.description: Kickstart your career with CloudScale Networks. You will work side-by-side with senior staff engineers to craft modern dashboard modules.
jobs.responsibilities:
• Build reusable React component interfaces with Tailwind CSS.
• Integrate with backend REST APIs and handle asynchronous states.
• Participate in code reviews and test automation sprints.
• Learn modern frontend bundling, profiling, and state management.
jobs.required_skills: React, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Git, REST APIs
jobs.qualifications: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or recent bootcamp graduate.
